system.description: Toxic mushrooms or spores: –1D to Athletics every six hours, and –2D Cunning plus –1D Endurance per degree each day. Death if penalty dice equal the ability.
system.effects:
Virulence 5; Toxicity 2; Frequency 1/6 hours and 1/day; Diagnosis Challenging (9).

Toxic mushrooms or spores: –1D to Athletics every six hours, and –2D Cunning plus –1D Endurance per degree each day. Death if penalty dice equal the ability.
system.recovery: Cunning penalties fade one die per day; Athletics and Endurance penalties are permanent unless a Destiny Point is burned (then 1d6 days).
